svg.text: #608 Enterprise Pharma & Biotech AI: 2-Stage Clinical Trial Patient Matcher & FDA eCTD Factory
Cloud & AI Solution Architect Guide · Screen 250,000 EHR Charts in 1.4h for $410/Trial (-97.8% vs. $18.75k All-LLM) · 96.4% Patient Recall
1. Clinical Trial Eligibility Funnel (250,000 EHR Charts)
✕ Naive Full-EHR LLM Screening (250K Patients × 25K Tok = 6.25B Tok)
• Running 70B LLM on every patient chart against 45 inclusion/exclusion criteria
• Cost: $18,750 / trial cohort · Runtime: 38.0 hours on 8× H200
✓ Two-Stage OMOP/FHIR SQL Pre-Filter + LLM Pathology Adjudicator
• Stage 1 (OMOP/FHIR SQL on CPU · 2.0s): Deterministic filter on age, ICD-10
stage, eGFR >= 45, ANC, HbA1c → Eliminates 91.2% ineligible patients instantly!
• Stage 2 (Remaining 8.8% = 22,000 Candidates on 8× H200): Qwen2.5-72B + XGrammar
evaluates unstructured oncology/pathology notes (ECOG status, prior line failure)
• Screening Time: 1.4 hours (27x faster) · Cost: $410 / trial (-97.8% vs. All-LLM!)
• Eligible Enrollment Recall rises from 62.0% (manual CRC review) to 96.4%!
2. FDA eCTD Regulatory Factory & 21 CFR Part 11
Zero-Hallucination Clinical Study Report (CSR / eCTD Module 2.5 & 2.7)
• Never let an LLM type p-values, hazard ratios, or adverse-event % from memory!
• Bind every prose statistic to SAS / R ADaM & SDTM table cell IDs via Jinja2
template slots ({{adam_t_eff_14_2.hr_95ci}}) → 0.0% numerical transcription error
• Compresses NDA/BLA medical writing cycle from 14 weeks to 12 days!
Hierarchical Molecular Virtual Screening Funnel (10M Compounds)
• Tier 1 (10M → 100K): RDKit 2D pharmacophore + Uni-Mol fast score (CPU/L40S, 1.5h)
• Tier 2 (100K → 2,000): DiffDock-L / EquiBind on 4× L40S (4.0h)
• Tier 3 (Top 2,000 Only): AlphaFold3 / Boltz-1 + FEP on 8× H200 (Overnight Tidal)
• Cuts 10M-compound screen cost by 98.4% while accelerating Phase-III launch by 4.5 mos
3. GxP & FDA 21 CFR Part 11 Validation Checklist
• Freeze exact model weight SHA-256 digests, container images, and seed=42 for all regulatory submission runs.
• Store immutable audit trails linking every eCTD paragraph to its source CSR table, SAS program hash, and medical writer e-signature.
